{{Quote|Beep beep!|The R5 unit|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
An '''R5''' [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. An [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] product of [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], the droid was [[Color/Legends|colored]] white with red trim.

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[R5-series astromech droid|R5 unit]] was working near a machinery room which controlled a security gate on a Theed street. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Trade Federation [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The droid met the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] shortly after the invasion started. At the time, Kenobi was [[Capture of Theed/Legends|escorting]] [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], posing as the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]]. Kenobi ordered the droid to stay and continue its work, as he didn't need a droid following him.

Later, when Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|returned to retake Theed]], the droid was still working at its position. Amidala met a [[Unidentified wounded Naboo guard 3|wounded Naboo guard]] and asked him how to get past the security gate. the guard directed her to the R5 unit. Amidala then asked the droid to open the security door so she could disable the generator and open the door. The R5 unit complied, and Amidala continued through Theed after she opened the security door.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You will never be able to climb these stairs. Return to your work.|A dialogue choice if the player (Kenobi) asks the droid to follow him and then changes his mind|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)" />}}
The R5 unit appears in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]] adaptation of the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Episode I'']] film. The player meets the droid in two missions. The player has several dialogue options with which to interact with the droid. This article assumes the player asked the droid to stay in its place during the first mission, and that it was available during the second to open the door. The game's [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] recommends following that option. If the droid is not available for the second mission, the player must interact with the wounded guard, who will give the player a passkey to bypass the security door.
